Show a narrow but clearly visible light/shadow AIR GAP directly under BOTH knees, between the bottom of the pants at each kneecap and the mat. Both palms remain planted at exactly the original positions beneath shoulders, all fingers flat and elbows naturally straight. Both flexed toes remain firmly planted at exactly the original positions, heels raised as in step 01. The shins now hover, never rest on the mat. Keep her back neutral almost horizontal, hips naturally at the same overall height as shoulder girdle, lift hip level only the few centimeters needed; no high-raised buttocks, no knee pulled up to chest. Chest and pelvis remain squared, no body rotation or forward shifting. Natural anatomy and stable proportions. Entire person, hands and feet stay fully in view with margins. Knee-to-mat gap must be legible at this camera angle. No words, arrows, labels, numbers, watermark, collage or second pose.
